BLAKE3 tracing, constants, flags, and compression function prototypes.

# Purpose
This header file defines private constants, flags, data layouts, and function prototypes for the BLAKE3 hash implementation. It sets the message schedule and initial vector values used by the compression function, and it defines flag bits that mark chunk boundaries, parent nodes, and root nodes in the BLAKE3 tree. The file also declares the internal `fd_blake3_op` scheduler record and the compression entry points for the reference, SSE, AVX, and AVX512 paths, including batch interfaces for vectorized processing. It also includes a trace switch, `FD_BLAKE3_TRACING`, that enables debug logging for BLAKE3 operations during development.
